text_block_list.text: (Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: <nickname>！ <nickname>！ <nickname>！ <nickname>！ <nickname>！ <nickname>！
—It was the scenery I had dreamed of.

To see <chrname> showered with cheers from a packed 
stadium... I had waited for this day.
choice_data_list:
(I've made it this far—so what lies 
ahead...?!)

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: It's <nickname>! <chrname> is the one...!

<chrname> lost the race. Yet—having made such a 
fierce statement with her presence, a 
massive, roaring cheer washed over her...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: <nickname>! You were so cool!

It wasn't quite the scene I had dreamed 
of... Yet a profound wave of emotion 
surged within me.

To see <chrname> showered with cheers from a packed 
stadium... I had longed for this day.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Let's go too, <nickname>! All of us Japanese 
Umamusume together...!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Let's aim for a much, much greater world! 
I'll be cheering you on--!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
"The times will change, for sure... they 
will. So don't cry, Su-chan."

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
"Let us believe. That someday, our dream 
will come true. That Japan will become 
one... and reach new heights. That that 
day will come—"

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Guess I'm getting old too.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: ――The next stage of your life begins here.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It appears... your 'personal matter' has 
also been fulfilled, my lord.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Your eyes always see through to the 
essence of things.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
You can see how high the fever runs in the 
Twinkle Series. Our job here is done. 
...Let us return to our own present.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—Yes. But... the scenery is definitely 
changing!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
For instance... look, that person over 
there!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text: Hee~~y! Speed Symboli~~!! Hey~~!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"She seemed like an ardent fan of Speed 
Symboli-san... She was cheering for her 
the entire time!"

text_block_list.name: A Certain Child
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Dad's favorite is so cool!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! —I'll watch the race! Because 
you're in it...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
See? Look how we managed to meet each 
other too, didn't we?!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"This bond will surely become a brand new 
sight to behold. Let's run together again 
someday!"

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
—The present brings along the past as 
well. And connects toward the future...

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
As long as our beloved children continue 
to run, the deeds and legacy of all of us 
Umamusume... will be passed down through 
the ages.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
"Let us continue to watch over them 
together. To see where their journey 
leads."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you. You're right... Let's just 
watch over them.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's head over to where our star 
is, shall we?
(Waaaaaaah...!)

The cheers for <chrname> continue to echo on, never 
seeming to fade.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: âCome on now, snap out of your daze!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Have a safe trip, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: St Lite
text_block_list.text:
It is precisely because of you that 
Umamusume are able to run.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Besides—look. She is waiting.

"<chrname> stands within the light. With unyielding 
resolve burning in her eyes..."

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Challenge without fear. The next 
legend—will be made by you.
